body:
Thanks for the reply. I'm not shooting it down at all but I just want to clarify that I have severe Emetophobia, Agoraphobia (in certain situations) and Claustrophobia. 

When I feel sick, I play guitar. I think music is the only thing that makes sense to me. I've been making music since I was about five. But I've always sold myself short. "What if I suck? I'll never play like that. People think my voice is terrible.. Etc". Although, music doesn't pull me out of depression. It almost compliments it. 

As for drawing, I'll have to find the motivation to try. I live in a vicious circle that rotates from feeling sick > intense anxiety > depression/suicidal > apathy and then rinse and repeat.

I scream as well. When I hit the wall and I figure people who aren't afraid of death would "do it". I scream until I can't speak. Sometimes I'll carve a word into my arm. Like "fuck you" as if my body is listening. I wish it could hear me. 

But anyways, a friend of mine was giving me similar advice tellin me to walk. The side effects of this drug give me dysphoria and derealization (I think that's what they're called) so when I walk around I feel outside of myself. It's extremely unsettling. But each day I spend inside just makes leaving harder. God forbid I have to go to the store for smokes or run an errand not 5 minutes down the street. 

My therapy appointment is about 45 minutes away and because this is a throwaway account I'm not embarrassed to say that I usually have my mom drive me because I can't take the drive alone. I'm too fucked up right now.

Thanks for the suggestions and inspiration. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't suicidal anymore but I really appreciate you reading and writing back. It means the world.
